Nonacyclic indexed graphs yield a nonempty original index subset and consistently oriented globally zero sum of coordinate differences. Arbitrary finite n, real inputs, loops ignored and parallel indices allowed in the indexed graph.

For N>=2, actual MAX_N cannot equal an arbitrary additive affine function plus a finite sum of arbitrary real functions each having one period vector v with v_i != v_j for some i,j. No continuity, measurability, diagonal invariance, or invariance under all real multiples is assumed for the summands.

For N>=3, every unrestricted real affine-skip/bias two-hidden-layer network computing actual MAX_N on every real input has an ORIGINAL second-neuron index k with nonzero output coefficient d_k and observation rank at least N-1. The observation is x -> (U_k dot x, (W_kj (A_j dot x))_j), so nonfeeding first rows vanish and no normalization or changed neuron indices are used.
